entries.reason: Known command queue state has one typed Protobuf schema; only open-ended order payload values use DynamicValue.
entries.schema: orders.command_queue version 2 uses CommandQueueSave with typed orders, events, indexes and counters.
entries.version: Binary and JSON writers emit version 2; version 1 JSON is read at the compatibility boundary.
entries.migration: Version 1 JSON restores into a detached queue and is recaptured as version 2 Protobuf.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively and validates enums, IDs, membership and event sequence.
entries.restore_atomicity: The live queue is replaced only after a detached candidate passes all checks.

entries.reason: The orders module exposes binary persistence and a compatibility JSON/script boundary.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: The queue owner calls save and restore; no callbacks run while restoring.
cost_notes: Binary save and restore cost linear time in orders, events and dynamic payload bytes per snapshot.
